clue.text: Wicked spirit was rebuffed

indicators.note: to rebuff is to push back, so the word for was is turned to run the other way

parts.note: was, in the sense of existed, is lived

explanation.surface: A ghost or demon found itself turned away.
explanation.definitionFit: A demon or fiend is the classic example of an evil supernatural being.

clue.text: It's primarily destructive, spreading it on leaf

definitions.text: It's primarily destructive, spreading it on leaf

indicators.note: primarily means only the opening letter of destructive is used
spreading the letters of it on leaf scatters them into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A garden chemical whose main job is to wreck foliage when sprayed on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spreading' rearranges IT ON LEAF to give EFOLIANT, after D from the start of destructive; the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Such a chemical is sprayed on plants to strip their foliage, which is indeed chiefly destructive.

clue.text: This is extremely visible, turning round what it orbits

definitions.text: This is extremely visible, turning round what it orbits

indicators.note: extremely means take the letters at the extremes of visible, its first and last
turning round means the word for the body it circles is read backwards

parts.note: the planet in question circles the Sun

explanation.surface: A planet that is very bright in the sky while it circles our star.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: the second planet is the brightest in the night sky after the Moon and circles the star at our system's centre.
explanation.definitionFit: The second planet is famously the most visible one and it orbits the Sun.

clue.text: Queen's lover left ring in window

indicators.note: in means the letters for left and ring are placed inside the word for window

parts.note: a lancet is a tall narrow pointed window
a ring is round, like the letter O

explanation.surface: A royal affair glimpsed through a window, with a ring left behind.
explanation.walkthrough: In Arthurian legend the knight had an affair with Queen Guinevere.
explanation.definitionFit: In Arthurian legend this knight was the lover of Guinevere, King Arthur's queen.

clue.text: Bird that's even harder to shoot than eagle

definitions.meaning: a large seabird of the southern oceans

definitions.text: even harder to shoot than eagle
definitions.meaning: in golf an eagle is two under par on a hole and the rarer score of three under carries this seabird's name

explanation.surface: A hunter's remark that one bird is trickier to bag than an eagle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shoot' is golf, as in shooting a score, not hunting; an eagle is two under par, so even rarer is three under.
explanation.definitionFit: The seabird is a plain synonym, and golfers name three strokes under par after the same bird.

clue.text: Part in opera Callas initially rejected

indicators.note: initially rejected means the first letter of the name is thrown out

parts.note: Maria Callas was the famous opera soprano

explanation.surface: An opera role that Maria Callas turned down at first.
explanation.definitionFit: A solo song in an opera is one of the parts a singer performs.

clue.text: Marginal organization included in British policy

indicators.note: included in means the word for organization goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: a line is a policy, as in the party line
order means organization, as in putting things in order

explanation.surface: A fringe group swept into British government policy.
explanation.definitionFit: Something only just on one side of a dividing mark is marginal, a near thing.

clue.text: Not the first film with story about King and I

indicators.note: about means the word for story goes round the other letters

parts.note: a tale is a story
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A movie about The King and I, the musical, that came later than the original.
explanation.walkthrough: The first motion pictures were silent; the films with sound came after, so they are not the first kind of film.
explanation.definitionFit: A film with a soundtrack followed the silent era, so it is a later type of motion picture.

clue.text: Clearly showing it's so, even when modified

indicators.note: modified means the letters of these words are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A statement that something is true even when altered.
explanation.definitionFit: In logic and linguistics the word means defining or showing by direct demonstration, pointing out plainly.

clue.text: Thoroughly clean key dipped in acid

indicators.note: dipped in means the letter for key is put inside the word for acid

parts.note: sour means acid in taste
C is a musical key

explanation.surface: A key soaked in acid to scrub it.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrub hard until spotless is the plain dictionary sense.

clue.text: Businessman at office entertained by connoisseur

indicators.note: entertained by means the piece for at office is held inside the word for connoisseur

parts.note: a fancier is an enthusiast or connoisseur, as of pigeons
in means at the office, at work

explanation.surface: A businessman at work entertained by an expert in fine things.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who deals in large-scale money matters is a kind of businessman.

clue.text: Extract from novel I thought a work of art

indicators.note: Extract from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A passage from a book that the reader thought a masterpiece.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for lithograph, a print made by stone printing, which is a work of art.

clue.text: Pay attention —— conversion of Roman numeral's wrong by fae-for of five

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Pay attention —— conversion of Roman numeral's wrong by fae-for of five': 'fae-for' is garbled (probably 'a factor'), more than an OCR misread allows and no scan to confirm
annotationWithheld.clue: Pay attention —— conversion of Roman numeral's wrong by fae-for of five

clue.text: Seek reward as boxer, say, part of target for rookie

parts.note: a boxer here is the dog breed, and a dog begs for a treat
the inner is the ring next to the bull on an archery or shooting target

explanation.surface: A novice boxer chasing prize money and aiming at a target.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boxer' wants to be a fighter; it is the dog that begs.
explanation.definitionFit: A rookie is a newcomer, someone just starting out.

clue.text: Capital and state on opposite sides of continent

definitions.meaning: the US capital city, in the District of Columbia

definitions.text: state on opposite sides of continent
definitions.meaning: the Pacific Northwest US state, at the other end of the country from the capital of the same name

explanation.surface: A capital city and a state of the same name at opposite ends of America.
explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to the American capital on the east coast and to a state on the west coast.

clue.text: Island turned over court, with another island providing grounds for trial

indicators.note: over here means covering, so the reversed island goes around the court and second island
turned means the name of the island is written backwards

parts.note: Elba is the Mediterranean island of Napoleon's exile
Iona is an island of the Scottish Inner Hebrides

explanation.surface: An island ruling overturned by a court, with another island giving grounds to sue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' here means covering: the reversed Mediterranean island wraps around the court and the Hebridean island, rather than sitting above them.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal wrong that gives grounds for a lawsuit is one that can be taken to court.

clue.text: Lack of originality shown by special interests

indicators.note: special suggests these letters are put in a particular new arrangement

explanation.surface: Lobbying groups showing a lack of fresh ideas.
explanation.definitionFit: Being hackneyed or stale is exactly a lack of originality.

clue.text: Steady business

definitions.meaning: steady as in stable, not wobbly

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both solid and stable, and also a company in commerce.

clue.text: Spy chief and I spread out, badly shot

parts.note: M is the head of the secret service in the James Bond stories
splayed means spread out wide

explanation.surface: A spymaster and an agent lie sprawled after a bungled shooting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' is a stroke in a game, not gunfire.
explanation.definitionFit: A stroke executed poorly in a game is a fumbled or mishit shot.

clue.text: Brains having information one exploits

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
I is the Roman numeral one
to exploit something is to use it

explanation.surface: Clever people who have the information that someone exploits.
explanation.definitionFit: Brains is an informal word for very clever people, prodigies.

clue.text: Mostly consider article incomplete and weak

annotationWithheld.why: Clue 'Mostly consider article incomplete and weak' has two parallel wordplays (THINK less K, THING less G) for one definition, which a single wp cannot hold
annotationWithheld.clue: Mostly consider article incomplete and weak

clue.text: Consistent source of funds in board activity

indicators.note: in means the source of funds sits inside the board game

parts.note: chess is a game played on a board
an angel is a financial backer, especially of a stage show

explanation.surface: A steady backer of money for a board game.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that never alters is constant, unvarying and consistent.

clue.text: Models needing adjustment on rare occasions

indicators.note: needing adjustment means the letters of Models are to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Fashion models only occasionally need to be adjusted.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done only now and then happens rarely.

clue.text: What polite waiter is doing that's unique, eg taking peculiar order

indicators.note: taking a peculiar order means the letters of these words are rearranged strangely

explanation.surface: A courteous restaurant waiter taking an odd, one-of-a-kind order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'waiter' is not a restaurant server but someone waiting their turn in a line.
explanation.definitionFit: A polite person waiting their turn stands in line, which is what this word describes.

clue.text: Show fear as pacifist when cut

indicators.note: cut means the last letter is chopped off the word for pacifist

parts.note: Quakers, the Society of Friends, are known for pacifism

explanation.surface: A peace-lover showing fear when wounded.
explanation.definitionFit: To tremble is to show fear physically.

clue.text: Son almost completely evil

indicators.note: almost means the final letter is dropped from the phrase for completely

parts.note: in full means completely

explanation.surface: A son who is very nearly wholly evil.
explanation.definitionFit: Wicked and evil are close synonyms for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Part of building fell

definitions.meaning: a storey or level of a building
to knock someone down, as a boxer does

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a storey of a building and also a verb meaning to knock down.

clue.text: Fatally hit when express appears, crossing line

indicators.note: crossing means the word for express goes across and around the letter for line

parts.note: to express something is to say it

explanation.surface: Someone fatally struck when an express train appears at a level crossing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'express' and 'crossing' suggest a train at a level crossing; express is the verb, to say.
explanation.definitionFit: To kill violently is the sense; slay is an old word for kill.

clue.text: What Amsterdam has more than one of? Correct

definitions.text: What Amsterdam has more than one of?
definitions.meaning: the city name starts and finishes with the same two letters, so both its ends read A and M
to correct is to put right, to revise

explanation.surface: A question about Amsterdam, then the word correct.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as AM END: Amsterdam begins and ends with AM, so it has two such ends.
explanation.definitionFit: To revise a text or law to fix it is to correct it.

clue.text: Total saint taken in by politician? It's hard to believe

indicators.note: taken in by means the pieces are held inside the word for politician

parts.note: a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party
all means the total, everything

explanation.surface: A saint fully taken in by a politician? Hard to credit.
explanation.definitionFit: An exaggerated anecdote is an unbelievable tale.

clue.text: With a yes, oddly, I put in my return without difficulty

indicators.note: oddly signals the letters of a yes are mixed up in an unusual way
put in means the word for I goes inside my

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Agreeing oddly, someone files a tax return with no trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' looks like a tax return; it is the profit or gain that comes easily.
explanation.definitionFit: Profit gained with little effort is a return obtained easily.

clue.text: Famous violin performs fast movements the wrong way

indicators.note: the wrong way means the word is written backwards

parts.note: darts means moves quickly

explanation.surface: A celebrated violin played with quick passages in the wrong direction.
explanation.walkthrough: A Strad is short for a Stradivarius, a violin by Antonio Stradivari.
explanation.definitionFit: A violin made by Stradivari is the most famous kind.
